desc: by address: the host's game crashes (TTYD_SYNC_BACKGROUND_AT ...:crash) and is opened again (relaunch, TTYD_SYNC_RESUME=1): it hosts on the same port with the same session id and its players' ids by place, so the guest, waiting for it all along and connecting again by itself, gets the same player number and seat back; the same progress at the end

log_must: test: the game ends at once \(a crash: no word, no Leave\)
test: the Multiplayer page's Open your room again
net: resuming the session this game had when it closed
co-op: player 2 is back: seat 2 again
co-op: the host's game is gone: waiting 120 seconds for it
co-op: the host's game is back after [0-9]+ ms: the wait is over
